name: Yamakura Ennosuke
source: Uncharacteristically friendly and chatty for a ninja, Ennosuke is warmhearted, energetic and outgoing. He makes decisions quickly, but can be careless at times. His strength is in his speed. He is also Gekkamaru's best friend.
